card.name: Reproduction and fertility word endings
card.fires_on: The last piece of reproduction-related words such as procreation, fertility, sterility, conceiving, and the word potential after reproductive. It appears in sexuality discussions and in drug-label fertility and contraception sections.

modes.label: Procreation in sex and marriage

card.writes: It pushes toward reproduction and fertility vocabulary, including Chinese words for childbearing and marriage.
